meta_description: Rob Mount Electrical is a trusted local electrician in Nottingham. Fast, reliable electrical work—repairs, installations, and inspections. Call now for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Burst socket, failing electrics, or planning a rewire? Rob arrives fast, diagnoses right, and fixes it properly the first time.
services_subhead: From emergency fault-finding to full house rewires, we handle domestic and light commercial work with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown circuits, faulty sockets, or dead lights? We diagnose and fix faults the same day, with callouts available evenings and weekends.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Safe, compliant installation and repair of heating system wiring, thermostats, and control panels—essential for reliable winter heat.

services.title: House Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Old cloth wiring or overloaded circuits? We replace dated installations with modern, safety-tested systems and upgraded consumer units.

services.title: Testing & Certification
services.desc: EICR inspections, portable appliance testing, and condition reports—all you need to keep your home safe and meet insurance requirements.

services.title: New Installations & Extensions
services.desc: Kitchen rewires, bathroom electrics, garden lighting, and new circuits for home offices—installed to Building Regulations and tested.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Earthing Work
services.desc: Trip switches, RCD upgrades, and earthing checks to bring your installation up to modern safety standards and prevent electrical hazards.

about_pullquote: I fix it right the first time. No guessing, no repeat call-outs.
about_para_1: Rob Mount Electrical was founded on the principle that local electricians should be honest, reliable, and fast. Over 18 years, Rob and his small team have built a solid reputation across Nottingham—from Wollaton to Beeston—by turning up on time, diagnosing faults properly, and finishing jobs when promised. Every job is tested and certified; no shortcuts.
about_para_2: Customers return to Rob because he explains what's wrong without the jargon and gives fair quotes—no hidden charges. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, the focus is always the same: safe, quality work that lasts. NICEIC registered and fully insured, Rob takes pride in knowing most of his work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Rob

reviews.text: Had a major fault with the kitchen circuit—sparking outlets and all that. Rob came out the same evening, found a loose connection behind the cupboards, and sorted it in under an hour. Really thorough, explained everything, and the price was fair. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Rob rewired our 1920s terrace last summer. Professional from start to finish—tested everything, left the place spotless, and gave us a full certificate. It's peace of mind knowing the house is safe now. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Lighting kept tripping at 11pm on a Friday. Thought I'd have to wait till Monday but Rob picked up and was here within the hour. Dead RCD—he replaced it and even checked the rest of the board. Can't ask for better service than that.
reviews.author: Michael S.
